title: Resonant solutions and (in)stability of the linear wave equation
summary: We revise the analysis of the acoustic wave equation, addressing the question whether the classical well-posedness implies the existence of an isomorphism between prescribed solution and data spaces. This question is of interest for the design and the analysis of discretization methods. Expanding on existing results, we point out that established choices of solution and data space in terms of classical Bochner spaces must be expected to be incompatible with the existence of such an isomorphism, because of resonant waves.
